description:
Configure an interactive image map on a system dashboard slide. The presentation at '/home/ga/Documents/Presentations/system_dashboard.odp' contains a dashboard image on Slide 1 and detailed metrics on Slides 2, 3, and 4. Your task is to use the ImageMap Editor to define 3 clickable hotspots on the Slide 1 image:

1. Top graph (CPU) -> Link to Slide 2
2. Middle graph (Memory) -> Link to Slide 3
3. Bottom graph (Network) -> Link to Slide 4

Save the presentation when finished.
